Desc:     PROBLEM: (a) Benchmark runs silently enable planning mode because ToolPreset=="benchmark" forces PlanningMode; (b) the Go runner is still the live entrypoint; (c) we must prove the bash runner produces equivalent cells before retiring the Go runner.

ROOT CAUSE: internal/serviceimpl/execute_native.go:265 reads `PlanningMode: req.PlanningMode || req.ToolPreset == "benchmark"`, leaking planning mode into every benchmark agent. cmd/bench/main.go still dispatches execution subcommands (matrix, sweep, run, plan) to the Go runner. There is no parity harness.

PROPOSED FIX:
- Agent-leak: delete the `|| req.ToolPreset == "benchmark"` clause at internal/serviceimpl/execute_native.go:265. Add `sampling.planning_mode: bool` (default false) to the profile YAML schema; update harness-adapters/fiz (from A2) to read it and append `--plan` when true. Find profiles relying on the preset via `rg -l 'preset.*benchmark|FIZEAU_PRESET' scripts/benchmark/profiles/` and add `sampling.planning_mode: true` to each.
- Deactivation: modify cmd/bench/main.go to short-circuit execution subcommands (matrix, sweep, run, plan) with the redirect 'use ./benchmark — see scripts/benchmark/README.md' and exit 2; listing subcommands (profiles, bench-sets) stay functional until PR F.
- Parity (ORDER REQUIRED — capture must precede the deactivation commit): run the Go runner against canary (sindri-lucebox + tb-2-1-canary, 3 reps) and commit 3 representative cell reports to scripts/benchmark/testdata/parity/go-runner/; run the bash runner (A3+A4) against the same canary and commit cells to scripts/benchmark/testdata/parity/bash-runner/; add scripts/benchmark/testdata/parity/diff.sh (bash + jq) reporting field divergence outside an allowlist (cell-id, timestamps, paths, and NEW fields such as harbor_runner_image_digest, model_server.commit).

NON-SCOPE: harbor image (A1); shell adapter creation (A2, this only wires planning_mode into fiz); runner core (A3); concurrency/budget (A4); plus parent out-of-scope: cell-report.schema.json (PR B), tasks_from/task_executor schema (PR C), Node collector (PR D), Node importers (PR E), deleting cmd/bench (PR F), docs (PR G).

GOVERNING ARTIFACT: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

DEPENDENCIES: A3 and A4 (bash runner must produce cells for parity and for the deactivation redirect to be safe); A2 (fiz adapter exists). Satisfies parent AC4, AC6, AC7. VERIFICATION REQUIREMENT preserved: parity fixtures captured before the deactivation commit merges.

2. TestBenchMatrix_RedirectExit2 (Go, cmd/bench): `fiz-bench matrix 2>&1 | grep -q 'use ./benchmark'` succeeds and the command exits 2 (parent AC6).
3. Test_parity_diff_clean (bash, scripts/benchmark/tests/parity.bats): scripts/benchmark/testdata/parity/diff.sh against the committed go-runner fixtures is clean per the allowlist (parent AC4).
4. Test_planning_mode_field_drives_plan: harness-adapters/fiz appends `--plan` iff sampling.planning_mode is true.
Gates: `go test ./internal/serviceimpl/... ./cmd/bench/...` and `go test ./...` pass; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes (shellcheck + bats).
